entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Provide an acquisition experience around linux native dependencies w/DNUP install #51113
  • Review file copying and hard linking in SDK layout #51112
  • Artifacts Path Layout causes intermittent build failures when any projects involved in the build have the same _name_ #51110
  • [dotnet-watch] .NET 10 RC2, browser doesn't update on first change of razor page #51107
    10.0.1xx

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E] Update to workload set mode failed with .NET 9.0.111. #51047
  • backgroud service can't stop when use dotnet watch #50952
  • dotnet workload install wasm-tools-net8 broken #51081

PullRequests

Created

  • Have copilot handle formatting better #51114
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Disable the hard link copy as this was causing the exe bundle to pick up the stage2 changes. #51111
  • Support variables in `#:project` directives #51108
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Convert numeric telemetry parameters to measurements for better analytics #51071
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1xx
  • Re-enable telemetry for global.json state - set error writer to swallow expected error messages #51089
    Servicing-consider
  • Added infrastructure to CODEOWNERS #51083
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Update man pages #51076
  • [release/10.0.1xx] URL-encode scoped CSS Link headers for non-ASCII project names #51039
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.1xx

Updated

  • Fix duplicate versions in `dotnet workload search version` when multiple feeds contain same version #50980
  • Improve workload search help text to clarify version searching capability #50982
  • Manual backport of 48874 to release 9.0.3xx #50940
    Servicing-approved, needs team triage, Partner request, Area-dotnet new, Branch Lockdown, 9.0.11
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Add `.slnx` to default `.editorconfig` template #51095
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.0
  • More LLM detections for other CLI agents + alter TL behavior in the presence of LLMs #51054
    Servicing-approved, Document for new feature, Area-Telemetry, 10.0.1xx
  • Fix `--project` and `--solution` descriptions for `dotnet test` MTP to use "test" instead of "run" and extract shared localization strings #51052
  • Run test template tests with Arcade #51020
  • Add telemetry logger support for API-based MSBuild usage #51068
  • [release/10.0.1xx][HotReload] Allow hot reload refresh script injection for 404 status code #51050
    Servicing-consider, Area-AspNetCore
  • Allow empty file-level directive values #51078
    Area-run-file
  • Avoid error when building file-based libraries #51063
    Area-run-file
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #51075
    Area-CodeFlow
